query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 8 countries by sampled innovations per visible ranked city in the 2021 report, where the metric is `total sampled innovations / number of entries in city_rankings`, values are expressed as sampled innovations per visible ranked city, only countries with at least two visible ranked cities are eligible, Canada and Sweden are excluded because of documented city-rank card-versus-body conflicts, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest.
value_unit: sampled innovations per visible ranked city
selection_rule: top 8 after visible_city_count >= 2 and excluding Canada/Sweden
